label: welcome
bodyText:
WELCOME
Hold on to your support and your clarity
Difficult moments can make it hard to reach your support and your clarity. Flare helps you reconnect with both.
Prepare them while you are thinking clearly, so they are ready when you need them most. Gather the reminders, plans, and encouragement you want available before a difficult moment, so you do not have to invent them when you are already overwhelmed.
Your support
The people and encouragement you have chosen to keep close when you need them.
Your clarity
The plans, reminders, and intentions you created while thinking clearly.
WHAT TO DO NEXT
Get started by preparing the support words, reminders, and next steps you want ready before you need them.
Get started
WHAT SIGNING IN ADDS
You can begin without an account. Signing in adds saved setup across sessions, account-backed history and plan reloads, and account-based features like Support Group.
Go to sign in
